LanguageData.Skylight_NoRoof: No roof above — open sky already lights this spot
LanguageData.Skylight_ThickRoof: Blocked by overhead mountain — no daylight gets through solid rock
LanguageData.Skylight_NeedsSupport: Must be within {0} tiles of a wall or pillar to hold up the roof
LanguageData.Skylights_DomeRadiusDesc: How far the soft light from dome and mountain-dome skylights spreads. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_SkylightsOnly: Skylights only — soft edge inward around skylights
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_Full: All roofs — soft edge inward at every roof edge
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdgeModeDesc: By default a roof's shadow fades outward onto the lit tiles just outside it. The inward modes keep those open tiles fully lit and instead soften the edge into the roofed tiles, so light appears to reach just past a skylight. Takes effect immediately.
